text: Program Overview Occupational Health and Safety Engineeringis a discipline and specialty that studies and implements practical aspects of protection and safety. In simple terms it is what organizations must do to make sure that their activities do not cause harm to anyone. Teaching Objectives Nature applied talents with strong practical ability and familiar with basic theory and basic knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety Engineering MainCourses System Safety Engineering, Safety Principle, Safety Testing and Monitoring, Safety Law, Safety Technologyand other Characteristic Courses Duration 4years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree of Safety Engineering by China University of Mining And Technology Future Career The graduates mainly work in the relevant enterprises, intermediary agencies and scientific research units such as institutions of higher learning in the Safety Technology and Engineering, Safety Inspection and Supervision, Safety Design and Production, Safety Education and Training of Senior Engineering in Building, Chemical, Mining, Energy and Transportation field.
